expectations.evidence: Word count is approximately 340 words, within the 300-400 range.

expectations.text: The topic (file permissions) is made engaging through character interaction
expectations.evidence: James and Emma discuss file permissions through a corporate access control analogy. Emma uses a whiteboard diagram, James connects to his finance background with document sharing tiers.

expectations.text: No As You Know Bob moments
expectations.evidence: James genuinely does not know Linux permissions; Emma teaches him. No shared-knowledge exposition found.

expectations.text: No passive James phrases: I understand, That makes sense, Fascinating, Yes I see are absent
expectations.evidence: None of the specific forbidden phrases (I understand, That makes sense, Fascinating, Yes I see) are present in the text. James's responses are statements and questions.

expectations.text: No lecture-voice Emma phrases: Let me explain, Great question, As you can see, So what happens is are absent
expectations.evidence: None of the forbidden phrases appear. Emma uses statements and analogies rather than lecture framing.

expectations.text: Every line of dialogue is load-bearing
expectations.evidence: Emma's line 'That is almost exactly how Linux does it' is filler agreement that could be cut. The exchange flows more like a textbook dialogue where Emma explains and James agrees, rather than every line advancing the scene.

expectations.text: James connects file permissions to his business operations background
expectations.evidence: James uses a finance analogy: 'three tiers: the author of a report, the finance team, and the rest of the firm. Each tier had different privileges: edit, comment, or view-only.' Also connects execute permissions to macros in financial models.

expectations.text: Emma makes the abstract concept concrete
expectations.evidence: Emma uses a whiteboard ASCII diagram breaking down rwx permissions, and connects to corporate document sharing. The diagram is concrete and visual.

expectations.text: The emotional tone matches grit/determination for Chapter 22
expectations.evidence: The tone is calm and tutorial-like. James is curious and receptive, not gritty or determined. There is no struggle, frustration, or earned understanding. The exchange reads as a smooth explanation rather than a hard-won insight.

expectations.text: At least 1 pushback exchange is present
expectations.evidence: James never pushes back or resists. He agrees with Emma throughout: 'So it is an access control matrix,' 'Read and write are obvious,' 'In my old firm, an analyst could...' All are agreement or elaboration, not pushback.
